outline:
數位工具已帶來設計思考、設計程序、合作與協同作業模式的改變，本課程就在探索數位工具與設計思考與方法之間的關連性，並訓練其數位設計建模與製造的諸多技能。

It has raised a revolutionary change, digital tools bring among design thinking, design procedure and their collaborative modes. The objective of this course is to explore the relationship among them, and to train the necessary skill related to digital presentation, modeling and fabrication.
